record.original_question: For an ε-perturbed KdV equation, does every solution remain ε^a-close to some finite-gap torus for times 0≤t≤T_ε with T_ε at least C_M ε^{-M} for every M>0, in the spirit of Nekhoroshev theory?

evidence.quote: Problem 4.3.7 (S. Kuksin) In the spirit of Nekhoroshev's theorem one can ask the following: does an arbitmry solution of a c:-perturbed KdV equation remain c:a -close to some finite gap torus during a time interval 0 ~ t ~ To: with To: ~ CMc:- M for all M > O?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the Korteweg–de Vries (KdV) equation under periodic boundary conditions,
  u_t + u_{xxx} - 6 u u_x = 0,  x ∈ T = R/Z,
viewed as an integrable infinite-dimensional Hamiltonian system. Its phase space (e.g. a Sobolev space H^s(T) of zero-mean functions) is foliated by invariant finite-gap tori, i.e. compact invariant tori obtained from finite-dimensional reductions of the integrable hierarchy.

Let ε > 0 be a small parameter and consider an ε-perturbation of KdV of the form
  u_t + u_{xxx} - 6 u u_x = ε F(u),
where F is a sufficiently regular (say smooth, Hamiltonian) perturbation.

Question: Does there exist a constant a > 0 such that, for every M > 0, there is a constant C_M > 0 with the following property? For every sufficiently small ε > 0 and every solution u(t) of the perturbed equation (with initial data in a suitable bounded region of phase space), one has
  dist(u(t), T_{ε}) ≤ ε^a   for all 0 ≤ t ≤ T_ε,
where T_ε is some finite-gap torus (possibly depending on the solution) and the time scale satisfies
  T_ε ≥ C_M ε^{-M}.

In other words, in the spirit of Nekhoroshev's theorem, does every solution of the ε-perturbed KdV equation stay ε^a-close to some finite-gap torus on time intervals longer than any prescribed inverse polynomial power of ε?
artifact.status_search_result: The general question of Nekhoroshev-type stability near finite-gap tori for perturbed KdV under periodic boundary conditions appears to remain open. Partial/related results are known: Bambusi–Gérard (2024) established a Nekhoroshev theorem for perturbations of the Benjamin–Ono equation with data close to finite-gap tori, and Kuksin and collaborators have proved averaging and KAM-type results for perturbed KdV, but no full Nekhoroshev-type statement covering arbitrary solutions of perturbed KdV in the stated form has been established.

status_evidence.title: A Nekhoroshev theorem for some perturbations of the Benjamin-Ono equation with initial data close to finite gap tori
status_evidence.snippet: For the Benjamin–Ono equation with data close to an N-gap state, actions remain O(ε^{1/(2(N+1))})-close for times exponentially long in ε^{-1/(2(N+1))}.
status_evidence.claim: Analogous Nekhoroshev result is recently proved for Benjamin–Ono, but not for KdV in the asked form.

status_evidence.title: Three theorems on perturbed KdV
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses long-time behaviour of solutions of perturbed KdV as infinite-dimensional analogues of classical perturbation results.
status_evidence.claim: Kuksin's known results on perturbed KdV are averaging/KAM type, not full Nekhoroshev.

status_evidence.title: Hamiltonian PDEs (Handbook chapter, Kuksin)
status_evidence.snippet: For nearly integrable nonlinear PDEs under periodic boundary conditions, no essentially infinite-dimensional Nekhoroshev result is known.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the general Nekhoroshev question for perturbed KdV remains open.
